text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Mhm, mhm...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer.
The race info is summarized concisely.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is a grand stage steeped in history, and the Umamusume to keep an eye on is Robroy-chan...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(I was so happy we could run together at the Takarazuka Kinen.
She told me I was a story... and taught me that I had something to leave behind.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(We ran in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup last year too.
The one to watch is Groove-san.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(I have a personal attachment to this race itself...
Above all, I want to answer the feelings of those
who said they want to race me again!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (The Mile Championship will be a challenge, but I think we can make it an exciting final race. The Umamusume to watch is Kawakami-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Kawakami-chan, who taught me the fiery passion of winning and losing.
I want to have another Japanese-style princess showdown with her~)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(And finally, the Arima Kinen...
It'll be a long-distance challenge for me, but
it's also a race where I can express my gratitude to the fans.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(The Umamusume to watch out for... first is Scarlet-chan.
I put on a shameful run in our last showdown, so I want to show her my absolute best.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (And—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Fine Motion's friend, Air Shakur, is also scheduled to run"...
Don't go calling me her pal without asking.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Taking your sweet time picking your final race, huh? You're awfully confident.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Things that must be chosen with great care.
As a finale, with firm resolve...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heh, resolve, huh...
Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Why are you laughing~? I'm seriously troubled here!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You really never learn, do you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You can't choose because you want to race against everyone at their absolute best, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Then let someone else worry about it too.
Are you the only one who has to steel your resolve?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“I see...
I can rely on my Trainer, can't I.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If she heard you say that, she'd cry, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, I didn't mean it in a weird way...
Wait, hold on, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
You had something you wanted to say to me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...I came to tell you
to enter the 'Arima Kinen'."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Running against you right now seems like it'll yield some useful data, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You are distinctly different from the rest.
And that's why... I want to crush you."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
After hearing what you just said, it wouldn't be fair, right?
That's why I dropped it, simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Fair"...? That doesn't sound like you at all, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you can say whatever you want
just as long as your language isn't foul?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm just teasing.
I already know how noble you are.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Say, I get the feeling
there was something else you wanted to say as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even at a time like this,
do I have to give you a cue?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Even if you don't intend to race,
come watch the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This is my "last" one too.
...I'm gonna struggle with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ! Shakur, you're...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come. You'd better show up, Fine.
...Because I'm going to shatter that resolve of yours.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...There are so many feelings, and everyone has their own circumstances.
As for me—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, Fine Motion asked me
to choose her target races.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Here's my opinion:
"I can't choose!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if I have no choice but to decide...
I want to rely on you.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I want to entrust it to you.
May I?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The race that Fine Motion
should run as her finale is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, understood!
To wrap things up, let's start a brand new story!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it! Once more...
As a queen, I'll leave my mark in everyone's hearts!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood!
At the very end, I will burn away every last ounce of my fighting spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, understood!
Let's put an end to it all...!
